name: release_train_shadow_p5_20261023
comment: ANCHOR: RELEASE_TRAIN_SHADOW_P5_20261023 — Phase 5 shadow is real. A shadow request reads the open-PR census
(ShadowQueueSource; the live source is unchanged), integrates the frozen members in a per-slot scratch worktree
(config/release_train_policy.json shadow block, fail closed), writes a ShadowTrainReport@v1 named in the receipt,
and never pushes, merges, promotes, claims, issues or writes control/latch/store/release state. STOP during each
phase halts shadow and live at that boundary; a corrupt latch (bad JSON, empty, directory, dangling link) fails
closed in the controller, the request lane and the CC reader; stale or wrong-SHA CI evidence never qualifies.
release_window.py train-shadow-tick forces one shadow tick per window. Hermetic: temp git repos, fake GitHub/host.
